candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The normalized mean velocity u+ is dimensionless, defined as the mean velocity normalized by the friction velocity u_tau. The input variables include wall-normal distance y (length), wall density rho_w (mass/volume), wall dynamic viscosity mu_w (mass/(length*time)), fluid density rho (mass/volume), dynamic viscosity mu (mass/(length*time)), and friction velocity u_tau (length/time). The dimensionless form u+ is constructed by normalizing velocity with u_tau, and length y is normalized by viscous length scale mu_w/(rho_w*u_tau). Thus, u+ is dimensionless with all SI exponents zero.
